subject: Fix NullReferenceException + recursive dialog cascade on failed decrypt
body:
Fix NullReferenceException + recursive dialog cascade on failed decrypt

LoadXmlConnectionData leaves _xmlDocument null when
LegacyFullFileDecrypt couldn't decrypt the file (e.g. a non-standard
XML declaration routes a plain-XML file through the legacy
full-file-decrypt path, the resulting password prompt is canceled, and
Authenticate() returns false).

Deserialize then called ValidateConnectionFileVersion(), which
dereferences _xmlDocument.DocumentElement on the null document,
throwing NullReferenceException. Runtime.LoadConnections caught that
exception and, since the file wasn't the startup connections file,
responded by re-showing the "Open Connection File" dialog - so
canceling the password prompt produced a cascade of dialogs that
looked like a hang.

Bail out with null right after LoadXmlConnectionData when _xmlDocument
is null, matching the documented "decryption failed" contract that
ConnectionsService.LoadConnections already handles cleanly (shows a
"Decrypting connection file failed" dialog, no exception).
patch:
--- mRemoteNG/Config/Serializers/ConnectionSerializers/Xml/XmlConnectionsDeserializer.cs
@@ -45,6 +45,18 @@ public ConnectionTreeModel Deserialize(string xml, bool import)
             try
             {
                 LoadXmlConnectionData(xml);
+
+                // LoadXmlConnectionData leaves _xmlDocument null when
+                // LegacyFullFileDecrypt couldn't decrypt the file (e.g. the
+                // user canceled the password prompt). Treat that the same as
+                // "decryption failed" - the caller (ConnectionsService) shows
+                // a clean error dialog for a null result. Without this check,
+                // ValidateConnectionFileVersion's null-dereference threw a
+                // NullReferenceException that Runtime.LoadConnections caught
+                // and responded to by re-showing the Open Connection File
+                // dialog, recursively.
+                if (_xmlDocument == null) return null;
+
                 ValidateConnectionFileVersion();
 
                 XmlElement rootXmlElement = _xmlDocument.DocumentElement;

triage.rationale: Our XML null guard already prevents the NRE, but still throws into Runtime’s recursive reload path; adapt the null-return behavior to current nullable code.

votes.concern: Early null return bypasses XmlException-driven backup recovery, turning a recoverable failed decrypt into an unrecovered failure.
votes.reason: This fork already prevents the null dereference and duplicate file dialog through guarded validation and explicit-file loading; importing this patch is redundant and regressive.

votes.concern: Fork may already handle decrypt-fail null path differently after heavy divergence.
votes.reason: Small clear NRE fix on failed decrypt; stabilizes load path; no deps; easy to verify.

votes.concern: Premise absent here: ValidateConnectionFileVersion already null-guards _xmlDocument, throwing XmlException handled by Runtime recovery dialog, no NRE or recursion.
votes.reason: Fork already prevents the crash differently; null-return would only slightly change which error dialog shows for legacy decrypt cancel — marginal value.

dissent: codex: REJECT - This fork already prevents the null dereference and duplicate file dialog through guarded validation and explicit-file loading; importing this patch is redundant and regressive.
claude: REJECT - Fork already prevents the crash differently; null-return would only slightly change which error dialog shows for legacy decrypt cancel — marginal value.
